decisions.reason: This certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line remains close to the firm's core thermal-engineering and service knowledge, so despite limited recent visibility management would more likely refine and support it than withdraw it.

The marine box cooler system builds directly on established marine cooling capabilities and earlier evidence of major market share, giving strong reasons to retain it and keep learning from the installed base.
The marine cooling unit fits the firm's existing marine applications, engineering know-how, and aftersales model, so the firm is well placed to improve it commercially rather than exit quickly.

The compact oil cooler is still related to the established exchanger portfolio, but with weaker visible market evidence than the marine products it faces a somewhat higher risk of rationalization even though management would presently keep it.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes draw on the firm's in-house R&D, process know-how, and cooperation experience, which supports continued development and use across its broader exchanger business.
